hardware.requirements: One direct 200 Gb/s cable between the two Sparks; both Socket Direct functions carry the RoCEnante one-shot all-reduce. Unified memory per rank holds 81 GiB of weights, the encoders, compiled graphs, the KV reservation and host processes.

model.quantization: fp8 attention and dense projections, MXFP4 routed experts (checkpoint fp8 quantization config with mxfp4 store dtype), bf16 DFlash draft
model.identity_note: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (MIT): 48 layers, 9 global-attention layers with 4 KV heads and 39 sliding-window layers with 8 KV heads and a 128-token window; Q/K head 192, V head 128; bundled five-layer DFlash draft (block size 8); vision and audio encoders. The pinned revision's dflash/config.json is valid JSON; earlier revisions need the launcher's corrected copy.

runtime.entrypoint: /opt/venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main serve, exec'd from a login shell (entrypoint attestation bypassed for the overlay)

serving.kv_cache_dtype: fp8 for the draft; the target keeps a bf16 KV cache (no checkpoint K/V scales; an fp8 target cache repeats itself on long outputs)
serving.attention_backend: TRITON_ATTN with V zero-padded to 192 (padded-V overlay) and the split-KV verification dispatch

collectives.all_reduce: B12X RoCEnante one-shot up to 2 MiB over both Socket Direct functions (VLLM_ENABLE_ROCE_ALLREDUCE=1, B12X_ROCE_HCA one device per PCIe domain); PyNCCL above

serving.sizing_note: The 16-sequence admission limit and the 12 GiB KV reservation are configuration choices bounded by host memory (earlyoom on the reference pair); they are not throughput or per-request guarantees.

evidence.conditions: Single site, 2026-09-22; single-stream 600-token decode, eight concurrent 300-token decodes at about 8K context, cold 48K and 120K prefill with 300-token decode, 1500-token repetition test at greedy and T=1.0; one image and one audio request.
evidence.result: Single stream 36.0 tok/s; C8 aggregate 91.3 tok/s; 48K cold prefill 2,183 tok/s with 33.7 tok/s decode; 120K cold prefill 1,488 tok/s with 29.7 tok/s decode; repetition tests clean; image and audio checks pass; 547,326 KV tokens.
evidence.conclusion: Serves text, image, video and audio requests on the published image with the recorded overlay. Not qualified: no soak, no accuracy suite, no independent reproduction.
limitations: Overlay files replace image sources at launch; the image's attestation entrypoint is bypassed.
Throughput values are single runs from one benchmark script on one day; the noise band from repeated baselines is about 3 percent single-stream and 5 percent at C8.
Video input is enabled but only image and audio requests were checked.

provenance.transport_implementation: B12X RoCEnante one-shot all-reduce with PyNCCL fallback
